annotation.title_clean: 国家卫生健康委关于医用设备集中采购的通知（国卫财务函〔2026〕131号）
annotation.title_en: National Health Commission Notice on Centralized Procurement of Medical Equipment (NHC Finance Letter [2026] No. 131)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委员会 (National Health Commission of China)
named_instruments_referenced: 卫规财发〔2007〕208号 Notice on Strengthening Centralized Procurement of Medical Devices
卫办规财发〔2012〕96号 Class A Large Medical Equipment Procurement Norms
卫办规财发〔2013〕7号 Class B Large Medical Equipment Procurement Guidance
annotation.summary_en: Chinese National Health Commission notice (May 2026) on centralized procurement of large medical equipment by public health institutions, setting provincial and prefecture-level procurement schedules, implementing agencies and reporting duties. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Provincial health authorities must organize centralized procurement of Class B large medical equipment, completing at least one round by end-2026
Each province to pilot prefecture-level centralized procurement in at least one city by June 2027
Health authorities designate a non-profit implementing institution for procurement
Provinces must file procurement plans with NHC by June 2026 and report annually
Repeals 2007 Ministry of Health notice on medical device procurement
